Ostium collateral refund, not new capital: the Transfer sender equals the repository-configured Ostium TradingStorage address, and the transaction targets the Ostium router. Parent audit identifies this as the recorded $5 collateral order timeout refund.

separate_funding_transaction_charge.status: Successful receipt includes this separate token outflow from the funding address. separate_gas.verification: Journal-only native funding amounts; exact native transfer transactions and transfer-time USD marks not verified. Historic Arbitrum state unavailable; traces/explorers inaccessible. No all-in USD total inferred.
